fixed_probe_comparison.exact_rule: Original whole training trace records compared exactly, without numerical tolerances; failed equality remains failed.
fixed_probe_comparison.scope: Between-policy empirical comparison, separate from source, per-branch consistency, and count/rate audit certification. Empty histories prove no endpoint equivalence.
fixed_probe_comparison.causal_attribution: Differences are observed; their cause is not established. Equal training actions do not imply equal frozen-fork actions or counters.
